name: context7
title: Context7
description: Search up-to-date documentation for any library, framework, or SDK — keep the ones you use offline, and ask Raycast AI about them
author: loris

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Context7 API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Without a key, Context7 serves a limited number of anonymous requests per month. Add a key from context7.com/dashboard to raise the limit.

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Verbose Logging
preferences.label: Enable detailed logging
preferences.description: Show detailed request and response logs in the console for debugging

commands.name: search-libraries
commands.title: Search Libraries
commands.description: Search Context7 for a library or documentation source

commands.name: my-libraries
commands.title: My Libraries
commands.description: Browse your saved libraries and refresh their documentation

commands.name: search-documentation
commands.title: Search Documentation
commands.description: Search documentation and code snippets inside a Context7 library

commands.name: my-snippets
commands.title: My Snippets
commands.description: Search the code snippets you saved, across every library

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

tools.name: search-libraries
tools.title: Search Libraries
tools.description: Search Context7 for libraries, frameworks, SDKs, or documentation sites by name, and get their Context7 library IDs. Call this first when a library ID is not already known — IDs are not guessable.

tools.name: get-documentation
tools.title: Get Documentation
tools.description: Get documentation and code snippets from one Context7 library, ranked against a natural-language question. Requires a Context7 library ID.

tools.name: search-my-libraries
tools.title: Search My Libraries
tools.description: Search only the libraries the user has saved to My Libraries, from their local offline copy. Fast, needs no network, and reflects what this user actually works with.

tools.name: add-library
tools.title: Add Library
tools.description: Save a library to the user's My Libraries and download its documentation for offline search. Asks the user to confirm.
